book.name: Ioanes
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Ioanes aime Iesu

content: Ties la ame ninimiap la betieng gare migana
Tiralo kan, na tara la tale ka okosarong Morowa panbinim ga kimanam ga tale ka betieng uriro la meivo “Ties” la ionama. Ga ionama ga Morowa, ga urie la kaina gare Morowa.
Eva, tiralo kan na tara la betieng panbinim ga kimanam ga ionama ga Morowa, ga namurit dalap lie.
Ga met uriro “Ties” la makosarong Morowa mirier pagap ganam. Ga karuk kan a paga ba na panbinim ga na kimanam la betong na noba alang. Karuk. Uriro “Ties” uriet la makosarieng pagap ga betmeng.
Memani, iriet muana o ninimiap ga mirier pagap la maiot la omela ninimiap aun. Ga ties kan la betieng ga are lalabie meba masingiala teip ga magaulap o ties ula migat.
Iriro gare lalabie, la ume ulabie na arubu, pa arubu la tale kan puoieng meba akurupeling.
Morowa la asagaong non migana ga muo. Bonim a iriro migana Ioanes.
Muo meba baisang a iriro migana la are lalabie, me teip ga magaulap meba meptang ties ang Ioanes ga naganmeng ties ang iriro migana.
Ioanes kan la tale iruo lalabie. Muot meba baisang a lalabie.
Iriro migana la are lalabie migat, ga ume ualo ties migat maun mirier teip ga magaulap ga maagaulie mirie la omeit uriro ties.
Iriro migana la muo ga unama na kimanam. Irie kan la okosarong panbinim ga kimanam, pa teip ga magaulap onim na kimanam la tale kan arakimeng.
Muo na gar Iudaiap ga unama na pianam ang kan Iudaia, pa gar ang kan la tale kan temeba aime ga alagimeng.
Pa mirier teip ga magaulap la alagimeng ga naganmeng gare ro, Iriro migana irie Karisito. Are ratmat ga uala kaguma maun meba betmeng gare lop am Morowa.
Tale kan betmeng gare lop am Morowa na olabuan ang mamo ga naga, o na agat ma neip, o na agat ang migana. Karuk. Morowa kan la makosarong ga betmeng gare lop am kan.
Ties la betieng gare neip a migana

Ga uriro la meiva “Ties” uaviam neip gare inamaniap la memaning, la unama kabirana pa. Agimapang la dakong o ubonuvarap ga tavuk ila migat, ga iriot la businguala irie la kauna gare Morowa. Eva, irirot la businguala iriet namurit Poi ang Morowa Mamo la asagaong ga muo.

Ga baisong Ioanes a Iesu ga marikong gare ro, “Iriro migana tinan la mirulo a. La tugama, ‘migana leba muong malonim tuo, irie la kakani ga amaning kaguma ga tokurupin. Memani, tara la tale ka toiat naga, unamar ga Mamo Morowa.’”
Bubuor ganam la buaram pagap mila mumurum la dakmeng aun: are ratmat ga dalap buo gat la dakmeng o ubonuvarap ang ula kakanu.
Memani, Morowa la ualo maimai aun Moses ga ualo Moses maimai maun teip ga magaulap onim Iudaia. Pa tavuk o ubonuvarap ga tavuk ila migat, Iesu Karisito kan la muo ga uala buun.

Karuk kan a noba migana onim na kimanam la agimaong Morowa. Karuk kan. Irirot namurit Poi ang Morowa, irie la kauna gare Morowa ga mitara naong Mamo aime. Eva, iriet narit la businguala a Morowa irie la kauna gare mani.
Bais ang Ioanes o unuvariap
Inamaniap mila uke a gar Iudaia la masagameng non miridaip ga non gar maiang livaip ga mamaio Ierusalem ga amarikmeng Ioanes gare ro, “Nunuo aga?”
Tie, tale kan uraio Ioanes ties. Uaramot ties gare ro, “Tale kan turuo Karisito.”

Ga amarikmeng, “Tie, nunuo aga migat? Atabo nunuo Elia, a?” Pa ugama Ioanes, “Karuk.” Inagat tiesmeng, “Tie, atabo nunuo iriro unuli la ugama Moses eba muong, a?” Pa ina upulo Ioanes ties gare ro, “Karuk.”
Are ratmat ga amarikmeng, “Nunuo aga? Meba papulang ties maiong inamaniap la pasagameng ga muvo. Tiesnung gare mani me nulam kan, a?”
Ugama Ioanes,

content.text: “Turuot gare nigunama la marikong na pianam la karuk ma inamaniap, ga ugama ‘Marangaming dalap mi ila kakani la namo muong titot.’ Are unuli Aisaia la tiesong.” Aisaia 40:3

content: Parasaiop la masagameng miriro teip ga mumaio. Are ratmat ga amarikmeng, “Nugama tale nunuo Karisito, ga tale nunuo Elia, ga tale nunuo iriro unuli pava Israel la man auanpala leba muong. Tie memani ga nuavariam teip ga magaulap. Aga la nouabu meba okosarnang uriro ubi, a?”
Ioanes la upulo ties maiong are ro, “Tumet tuavariam teip ga magaulap o burunam. Pa kabirana mi non migana la dusong. Pa tale amit.
Iriro migana la muo malonim tuo. Pa turuo kan la tale kan migana ila muri meba okosartang ubi gare migana o ubi ga aviktang karavut la avisong kiban a.”
Ioanes la uaramo uriro ties Betania toma na taralap o danuot Ioridan. Na uriro pianam la uavariam Ioanes teip ga magaulap una.
Iesu irie tatak Sipsip ang Morowa

Na urie non la tubiat, agimaong Ioanes Iesu la unum ga muo ai. Ga ugama Ioanes, “Agimaming, irie la Poi ang tatak Sipsip ang Morowa. Eba oduratang kirinim maiong mirier teip ga magaulap ganam onim na uro kimanam.
Irirot migana tinan la tiestung aime, ‘Non migana leba muong malonim tuo, irie natauan ga tokurupin. Memani, unama kan tiralo ga Morowa na tara la tale ka tovarangeieng naga.’
Turuo kan la tale kan arit irie aga migat. Pa muruot tuavariam teip ga magaulap o burunam meba masingtala a iriro migana.”
Ga tiesong Ioanes la uakap gare ro, “Agimarung ara Muranama Ila Babai la mavo na panbinim ga muo lourup gare baima ga ula unama abuo na tara la tuavaria.

Turuo kan la tale arit la irie Karisito. Pa Morowa la tosagaong ga muruo meba tavareim teip ga magaulap o burunam. Irie la toulo, Leba ‘Agimanang Muranama Ila Babai la muo lourup ga unama bo non migana, tie irirot migana leba avareim teip ga magaulap a Muranama Ila Babai.’
Turuo kan la agimarung ara ga baistung o ties gare ro, ‘Iriro migana irie Poi ang Morowa.’”
Iesu la maiteong nagala ma lop o usingnualap
O non la tubiat Ioanes la dusong ga narain kulen angan o usingnualap.
Ga agimaong Iesu la unum ga ula. Ga ugama Ioanes, “Agimaming, irie Poi ang, taktak Sipsip ang Morowa.”
Lopien angan Ioanes o usingnualap la lipta la tiesong gare tiro ga lila aliuluan Iesu.
Terigiong Iesu ga legimaong la aliuluan ga leulo, “Maga aisinmang man paga?” Pa alilo, “Rabi, nunama na man luguan?”
Pa leulo gare ro, “Mumang ga agimamang.” Tie lila agimaliong luguan la unama Iesu ana. Lionama ga irie are nagala o muabari nabit puoieng na arubu.
Tie, Andrias, papa ang Simon Petro, litiro teipien la lipto ties ang Ioanes ga lila aliuluan Iesu.
Lake ka ula aisinong tatak papa ang, Simon ga aulo, “Agimapang ara irie Mesaia.” Ogimabuong uriro bonim “Mesaia” kaina gare “Karisito”.
Ga alagiong Andrias Simon ga ula ai Iesu. Agimaong Iesu Simon ga ugama, “Nunuo Simon, poi ang Ioanes. Tubiat eba nomeivang inamaniap Kepas.” Origibuong “Petro”. Muana o uriro bonim “Tadas”.
Iesu la lemarikong Filip ga Natanael
Tubiat o non la, namo ala Iesu na provins Galili. Ga aup Filip ga aulo gare ro, “Tonouluo.”
Filip irie migana onim na taun Betsaida, pianam ang Andrias ga Petro.
Ga ula Filip aup Natanael, ga aulo, “Irie migana tinan la omirong Moses ties aime ga unulip gat la omirmeng ties aime irie la, apop ara. Irie Iesu onim Nasaret, poi ang Iosep.”
Pa upulo Natanael, “Onim Nasaret? Atabo noba paga ila muri la puoong meba maagaalie inamaniap leba betang na kilan a noba migana onim Nasaret, a?” Aulo Filip, “Munang agimanang.”
Iesu la agimaong Natanael la muo ai ga tiesong aime gare ro, “Agimanang, irie migana migat onim Israel. Karuk kan o kakarabunim ba la iot ira a.”
Pa amarikong Natanael gare ro, “Are mani ga tonit?” Upulo Iesu ties ang gare ro, “Tinan la tale ka nomarikong Filip, nogimarung la nunama na muana o kuguom a fik.”
Pa upulo Natanael ties ang gare ro, “Migana o usingnualap, nunuo Poi ang Morowa. Nunuo Orong onim Israel.”
Pa ugama Iesu aime, “Norulo la nogimarung na muana o kuguom fig, irirot muana ga nagannung ira ruo, a? Tubiat la eba magimanang pagap mila kakanim la makurupmein miriro.”
Ga Iesu la aulo gare ro, “Norulo migat: Tubiat la eba ogimanang panbinim leba inavang. Ga angelop am Morowa leba mela nakap ga mumaiong lourup toi, Migana migat ang Morowa.”

footnotes.text: Rabi are migana o usingnualap o ties buong.
